title: Aya Expanse: Combining Research Breakthroughs for a New Multilingual Frontier

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4: original Arena-Hard-Auto "measures win-rate ... from GPT-4-0314 with GPT-4-Turbo as a judge"; these authors use GPT-4o instead

prompt.note: No GPT-4-Turbo prompt is used or printed; the paper's own LLM-judge prompt (footnote 3, following Ustun et al. 2024) is for gpt-4o-2024-08-06.

claim.metric: none for the live id (GPT-4-Turbo is only cited as the judge used by the original Arena-Hard-Auto benchmark, not run by these authors)

data.source: Multilingual ArenaHard (translated Arena-Hard-Auto, 500 prompts x 22 languages) and Dolly human-edited/machine-translated sets (Table 1)

notes: The only live model these authors actually run as judge is gpt-4o-2024-08-06 (footnote 3), which is also not on the tracked still-callable list (only gpt-4o-2024-05-13 is). GPT-4-Turbo appears solely as a description of a prior benchmark's methodology, cited for contrast.
